facts.text: Roseman University uses a block curriculum where students take only one class at a time, focusing intently on that content area before proceeding to the next block.

sources.title: Six-Point Mastery Learning Model® - Roseman University
sources.quote: With a block curriculum, students take only one didactic class at a time, focus intently on that content area, and master the content before proceeding to the next block or course.
